description: Adding Ania credits without leaving the chat. Without `amount`: the options and the balance; with `needed` (the price of what the user wants) it also says how much is missing and suggests a top-up. With `amount` (reais) and `method: "card"` (the default outside pt-BR) it returns Stripe’s own card payment page for that exact amount (R$ 5 to R$ 2000, valid 1 h, no sign-in); show the link. Brazilian Portuguese users ONLY (language pt-BR): `amount` without method creates a PIX charge (Brazilian instant payment, R$ 5 to R$ 500) and returns the copy-and-paste code, a QR image/link and its expiry (1 h); show the code verbatim in a code block. The credit lands by itself once the bank confirms; later, `txid` checks whether it was paid (do not poll). Asking twice with the same amount returns the same open charge. Never mention or offer PIX to users in any other language: for them only the card page exists. Saved card (opt-in): only if the user asks to keep the card for next time, pass `save_card: true` with the card page; Stripe says so on the page. Later, `method: "saved_card"` charges that card from the chat after the user’s explicit yes to the exact amount (confirmation form, or the question + confirmation_id like any spend), within this connection’s per-spend limit and monthly cap (R$ 5 to R$ 500); otherwise it returns the card page instead. Never ask for card or bank details in the chat.

amount.description: Top-up amount in Brazilian reais, said by the user: PIX (pt-BR only, 5 to 500), card (5 to 2000) or saved card (5 to 500).

card_id.description: saved_card: which saved card (default: the most recent one).

confirmation_id.description: O confirmacao_id que a primeira chamada devolveu com a pergunta (vale 10 min). / The confirmation_id the first call returned with the question (10 min).

language.description: Always pass it: the language the user is writing in right now, as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'), not the app's interface language. Replies, prices and the card follow it.

method.description: pt-BR users: "card" for the Stripe card page instead of PIX. Others: card. "saved_card": the card the user saved earlier.

needed.description: Price in credits of what the user wants to buy now; the reply says how much is missing.

save_card.description: Card page only, and only when the user asked: save the card for later top-ups from the chat.

txid.description: pt-BR users only: the txid a previous top_up returned, to check whether that PIX was paid.

user_confirmed.description: true SOMENTE na segunda chamada, depois que o usuário respondeu "sim" no chat à pergunta com o valor exato; junto com confirmacao_id. / true ONLY on the second call, after the user explicitly said yes in the chat to the question with the exact amount; send it with confirmation_id.
